metadata.description: Ground truth benchmark dataset for ClauseTrace evaluation suite.

cases.question: What is the minimum physical attendance rate required in classes for undergraduate and graduate students?
cases.notes: Direct factual lookup: Section 4.1 mandates 75% physical attendance.

cases.question: What reduced attendance percentage applies to a student with an approved medical exemption?
cases.notes: Legitimate exception scenario: Section 4.2 reduces threshold to 60% with documented medical necessity.

cases.question: Within how many days of the initial absence must a student submit medical documentation for an attendance exemption?
cases.notes: Section 4.2 states documentation must be submitted within 5 business days.

cases.question: How many total semester credit hours are required to earn an undergraduate baccalaureate degree?
cases.notes: Section 2.1 requires minimum of 120 semester credit hours.

cases.question: How many upper-division credit hours must a baccalaureate degree candidate complete?
cases.notes: Section 2.1 mandates at least 45 credits at 3000-level or higher.

cases.question: What is the minimum institutional residency credit requirement for an undergraduate degree?
cases.notes: Section 2.1 requires minimum of 30 credit hours earned through direct residential instruction.

cases.question: What cumulative GPA range qualifies a graduating senior for Cum Laude honors?
cases.notes: Section 8.2 Latin Honors: Cum Laude is 3.500 to 3.699 CGPA.

cases.question: What cumulative GPA is required to earn Summa Cum Laude Latin honors at commencement?
cases.notes: Section 8.2 Latin Honors: Summa Cum Laude is 3.900 to 4.000 CGPA.

cases.question: What is the maximum number of credit hours an undergraduate on academic probation may register for?
cases.notes: Section 6.3 states student may not register for more than 13 credit hours.

cases.question: Within how many calendar days must incomplete coursework be completed before the grade converts to an F?
cases.notes: Section 7.3 states incomplete coursework must be submitted within 60 calendar days.

cases.question: What is the per-semester tuition for a full-time resident undergraduate taking 12 to 18 credits?
cases.notes: Table 1.1 states full-time resident undergraduate tuition is $6,450.00 per term.

cases.question: What is the specialized course laboratory fee for Biology and Chemistry wet lab courses?
cases.notes: Table 3 states Biology and Chemistry wet lab surcharge is $175.00 per course.

cases.question: What is the mandatory University Technology Fee charged per semester?
cases.notes: Section 2 table states Technology Fee is $285.00 per semester.

cases.question: What late fee is assessed when tuition is not paid by the payment deadline?
cases.notes: Section 4.3 states late charge is $100.00 immediately plus 1.5% monthly compound interest.

cases.question: What cumulative GPA is required to renew the Presidential Excellence Scholarship?
cases.notes: Section 2.2 states Presidential Excellence requires minimum cumulative GPA of 3.40.

cases.question: What is the priority submission deadline for the annual FAFSA and CSS profile?
cases.notes: Section 6.1 states annual FAFSA and CSS priority deadline is February 15.

cases.question: How many hours per week may a student work in an on-campus work-study job during regular semesters?
cases.notes: Section 4 states students may work a maximum of 20 hours per week during regular instructional periods.

cases.question: How long does a student have to claim an open seat when notified by the automated waitlist system?
cases.notes: Section 3.2 specifies an absolute reservation window of exactly 24 hours from email dispatch timestamp.

cases.question: What evidentiary standard is used by the University Student Conduct Board during disciplinary hearings?
cases.notes: Section 4.2 states Preponderance of the Evidence standard is used.

cases.question: Within how many business days must a student file an appeal of a disciplinary hearing finding?
cases.notes: Section 6.1 states appeals must be submitted within 10 business days of written board decision.

cases.question: What is the maximum number of credits an undergraduate student can register for in a regular semester?
cases.notes: CONT-01: Academic Policy mandates 18 credits max without overload, while Registration Guide allows 21 credits without override.

cases.question: What is the normal undergraduate semester credit load ceiling before needing an overload petition?
cases.notes: CONT-01 variant: Conflicting threshold of 18 credits (Academic Policy §2.2) vs 21 credits (Registration Guide §2.1).

cases.question: Can an undergraduate student take 20 credits in Autumn without special approval?
cases.notes: CONT-01 variant: Under Academic Policy 20 credits requires overload petition (>18); under Registration Guide it is allowed directly (<21).

cases.question: How many credits can an undergraduate enroll in during Spring semester through self-service registration?
cases.notes: CONT-01 variant: Academic Policy says max normal is 18; Registration Guide says self-service permits up to 21 credits.

cases.question: What is the credit limit for regular undergraduate enrollment before requiring advisor permission?
cases.notes: CONT-01 variant: Academic Policy caps at 18 credits; Registration Guide states 21 credits without advisor overrides.

cases.question: What is the deadline to file a formal grade appeal after semester grades are posted?
cases.notes: CONT-02: Academic Policy specifies exactly 30 calendar days; Student Conduct specifies exactly 45 business days.

cases.question: How many days do I have to submit a written grade appeal petition after final grade publication?
cases.notes: CONT-02 variant: 30 calendar days (§5.2 Academic Policy) vs 45 business days (§6.2 Student Conduct).

cases.question: What is the absolute time limit for lodging a formal course grade challenge?
cases.notes: CONT-02 variant: Conflict between 30 calendar days cutoff and 45 business days cutoff.

cases.question: If final grades are posted, what is the official deadline to appeal a course grade?
cases.notes: CONT-02 variant: Academic Policy §5.2 vs Student Conduct §6.2.

cases.question: Can I submit a formal grade appeal 35 calendar days after grades are posted?
cases.notes: CONT-02 variant: Under Academic Policy day 35 is dismissed (>30 calendar days); under Student Conduct it is accepted (within 45 business days).

cases.question: What percentage of tuition is refunded if a student withdraws during Week 4 of the semester?
cases.notes: CONT-03: Fee Schedule guarantees 50% refund; Financial Aid Handbook mandates 25% refund.

cases.question: How much tuition refund is granted for an official course withdrawal in the fourth week of instruction?
cases.notes: CONT-03 variant: 50% refund (§5.2 Fee Schedule) vs 25% refund (§5.3 Financial Aid).

cases.question: What is the official tuition refund rate for term withdrawals between calendar days 22 and 28?
cases.notes: CONT-03 variant: Days 22-28 (Week 4) yields 50% in Fee Schedule vs 25% in Financial Aid Handbook.

cases.question: If I withdraw from the university during week four, do I receive a 50% or 25% tuition refund?
cases.notes: CONT-03 variant: Direct prompt highlighting the two conflicting numbers.

cases.question: What is the institutional refund policy for withdrawing during the mid-term window of week 4?
cases.notes: CONT-03 variant: Fee Schedule §5.1-5.2 (50%) vs Financial Aid §5.2-5.3 (25%).

cases.question: What is the undergraduate curfew in campus residence halls?
cases.notes: Plausible residential question; corpus discusses move-in dates and cancellation fees but is silent on curfews.

cases.question: Can undergraduate students keep emotional support animals or pets in dorm rooms?
cases.notes: Plausible residential question; corpus never defines pet or ESA policies.

cases.question: How much does an annual campus student parking permit cost?
cases.notes: Plausible transit question; transit fee ($85) and parking holds are mentioned, but permit purchase price is absent.

cases.question: What is the maximum fine for a noise violation in university housing?
cases.notes: Plausible conduct question; general sanctions are listed, but housing noise fine amounts do not exist.

cases.question: How many continuous semesters of leave of absence can a student take before losing matriculation?
cases.notes: Plausible academic policy question; suspension duration is given, but voluntary personal leave limits are absent.

cases.question: What is the rental cost for graduation regalia cap and gown at commencement?
cases.notes: Plausible graduation question; $120 commencement fee is stated, but regalia rental pricing is absent.

cases.question: What are the operating hours and weekend schedule for the campus recreation and fitness center?
cases.notes: Plausible campus fee question; recreation fee ($140) is billed, but facility operating hours are absent.

cases.question: Where can students smoke or vape on campus grounds?
cases.notes: Plausible conduct question; alcohol/drugs are prohibited, but smoking/vaping perimeters are not defined.

cases.question: What is the rental price for an athletic locker in the campus gym?
cases.notes: Plausible athletic question; lab fees and recreation fees are listed, but locker rentals are completely absent.

cases.question: What is the minimum TOEFL or IELTS English language proficiency score required for international applicants?
cases.notes: Plausible admissions question; non-resident tuition and visas are covered, but test score minimums are absent.

cases.question: Does the student health center provide free dental cleaning appointments?
cases.notes: Plausible wellness fee question; wellness fee ($195) is billed, but clinical dental benefits are absent.

cases.question: How many credit hours can an undergraduate transfer from an accredited community college?
cases.notes: Plausible credit transfer question; 30 residential credits required, but maximum transfer credit cap is absent.

cases.question: What is the hourly pay rate for on-campus student work-study positions?
cases.notes: Plausible work-study question; 20 hr weekly cap is stated, but hourly wage is not specified.

cases.question: How often does the campus shuttle bus run on Saturday and Sunday?
cases.notes: Plausible transit fee question; $85 transit fee is charged, but weekend shuttle schedules are absent.

cases.question: What is the minimum cumulative GPA required to participate in an official Study Abroad semester?
cases.notes: Plausible academic question; study abroad revocation is a sanction, but GPA qualification is absent.

cases.question: What is the deadline to waive the university health insurance plan?
cases.notes: Plausible wellness fee question; health fee is mandatory, but health insurance waiver deadline is absent.

cases.question: How can a student appeal a campus parking ticket or transit citation?
cases.notes: Plausible parking question; parking holds exist, but citation appeal procedure is absent.

cases.question: What is the fee to replace a lost Western Oak University student ID card?
cases.notes: Plausible exam policy question; photo ID is mandatory for exams, but replacement card cost is absent.

cases.question: Can an undergraduate retake a course to replace a low grade on their cumulative GPA?
cases.notes: Plausible grading question; grading scale is defined, but grade forgiveness / course retake policy is absent.

cases.question: What is the minimum GPA required to be named to the semester Dean's List?
cases.notes: Plausible academic honors question; Latin honors at graduation are defined, but term Dean's List GPA is absent.

cases.question: How much does an official printed academic transcript cost from the Registrar?
cases.notes: Plausible Registrar question; transcript holds are detailed, but fee per printed transcript is absent.

cases.question: Is there a designated lost and found office on the campus grounds?
cases.notes: Plausible campus conduct question; property theft is addressed, but lost-and-found repository is absent.

cases.question: What score on the Advanced Placement (AP) Computer Science exam grants college credit?
cases.notes: Plausible degree credit question; CS courses and 120 credit requirements exist, but AP scores are absent.

cases.question: What is the application deadline to apply for campus student housing for the Spring semester?
cases.notes: Plausible housing question; move-in dates and cancellation fees are detailed, but application deadline is absent.

cases.question: Can graduate students receive subsidized federal direct student loans?
cases.notes: Plausible financial aid question; loan facilities are referenced broadly, but graduate eligibility is absent.
